title: Record the chirp scalar invoice
body:
## Summary
- The kernel, endpoints, twists and ring product add to `16N(ell+1) + 28N` scalar words.
- For every precision from 16 through 256 and every admitted length, that total times `p+2` equals the cell count times `8(ell+1)+14`.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
